t: You are standing at the Merchant Seamen's Memorial, a war memorial in the London Borough of Tower Hamlets. It was designed by Sir Edward Maufe, an architect remembered chiefly for his places of worship and memorials. Guildford Cathedral and the Air Forces Memorial are probably his best known buildings, and he was long associated with the Imperial War Graves Commission. The memorial's sculpture is the work of Charles Wheeler, an English sculptor. Together they gave this site a quiet and dignified setting for remembering those who served at sea.
